\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Panels: populism, ideology ($-$1 to +1) and the five liberalism scores (0--10). Bars: mean $\pm$ 1 standard deviation over the baseline manifestos of all parties, right-wing and right-wing populist parties in the world, Latin America and Argentina; right-wing = ideology $> 0$; right-wing populist = ideology $> 0$ and populism above the baseline median (3.97); no Argentine baseline manifesto has an ideology score above zero. Red diamonds: the 5 platforms of La Libertad Avanza 2021--2025; blue dots: the 33 other Argentine platforms 2021--2025; all filed with the C\'amara Nacional Electoral and scored out of sample with the identical pipeline and aggregation rule as the baseline (CF = Capital Federal, BA = Buenos Aires province; 2023 = national platform, filed for the primaries (PASO) and the general election). Teal squares: the platforms of the Republican Party (Manifesto Project code 61620) of 2016, 2020, 2024, baseline manifestos; the 2020 convention re-adopted the 2016 platform.\end{minipage}
